title: WOFOST Crop-Owner Optional-State Persistence Completeness and Minimality Qualification
goal: Qualify that every currently supported WOFOST crop-owner optional-state layout can be exported, reconstructed and process-restarted without losing continuation semantics, while inactive options remain absent and incur no hidden persistent state.

required_edge_layout.name: EMERGED_BIOMASS_EXPLICIT_ZERO_LENGTH_COHORT_ARRAYS
required_edge_layout.policy_question: The current external codec represents zero cohorts by count=0 and reconstructs them as unallocated arrays. Qualification must determine whether this is a semantically safe canonicalization or a restart-completeness defect. It may not be silently called bitwise state identity.
required_edge_layout.pass_rule: Canonicalization is admissible only if validation, active cohort count, living leaf biomass, leaf area sum and subsequent qualified crop behavior cannot distinguish allocated-zero from unallocated-zero cohort state. Otherwise fail closed and open a production persistence fix.

required_checks_per_valid_layout: owner optional allocation presence is preserved except only an explicitly qualified zero-length cohort canonicalization
all scalar continuation values are exact
all nonempty cohort arrays are exact
external process-restart adapter write/read succeeds without owner source generation
external representation is identical under O0 and O2
minimality_checks: inactive crop artifact carries no biomass payload values beyond presence/count metadata required by the qualification codec
absent evolution state produces no evolution payload body
absent B110 compatibility state produces no B110 payload body
parameters, forcing, solver scratch, warm-start vectors and accepted-window cache remain absent
no optional component is allocated by reconstruction when its presence flag is false
hard_constraints: no production persistence API broadening unless a demonstrated completeness defect requires it
no file or parser dependency in kernel or crop owner modules
no persistence of retired accepted-window cache
no claim beyond the current owner-state type surface
invalid layouts must fail closed before a ready committed state is published
nonclaims: not qualification of future WOFOST optional state not present in the current owner type
not a production SWAP-wide restart format
decision_rule: Close positively only if every current valid owner layout roundtrips with exact continuation semantics, absent options remain absent, all invalid layouts fail closed, and any zero-length cohort normalization is explicitly proven observationally equivalent rather than assumed.
